fields.why: Incidence, hospitalization and testing rates and ORs are reported for each of the 5 HII deprivation quintiles, an outcome measured in each of 5 SPD groups.
The HII is an area deprivation index (income, poverty, unemployment, education), which the brief counts as SES; race/ethnicity appears only as an area characteristic in Table 3.

Each quintile is assessed only by an OR against the very-low quintile, judged by the stated rule that CIs not spanning 1.0 are significant; no trend or omnibus test is reported, and the Table 1 side-by-side rates are outranked by precedence.
